title: Empathy Trap
subtitle: Test your understanding of the Empathy Trap — how organic empathy is turned toward charity fraud, NPC mimicry, and loosh.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Organic empathy is spiritual firmware. Charity ads and fundraising drives siphon money into Deep State operations while distress feeds loosh collectors. Severing psychological hooks restores empathy for genuine soul family resonance.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the Empathy Trap within custodial control?

options.label: A
options.text: The Empathy Trap erases the organic spiritual firmware present in the prefrontal cortex at birth.
options.rationale: Parasitic controllers cannot delete this organic attribute so they invert its function.

options.label: B
options.text: The Empathy Trap forces non-player characters to generate synthetic loosh through simulated distress.
options.rationale: Non-player characters do not possess organic spiritual energy that can be harvested as loosh.

options.label: C
options.text: The Empathy Trap is the systematic subversion and weaponization of organic human empathy that directs pure compassionate resonance toward fraudulent targets.
options.rationale: The Empathy Trap is the systematic subversion and weaponization of organic human empathy by directing pure compassionate resonance toward fraudulent targets.

options.label: D
options.text: The Empathy Trap replaces human emotional memory with holographic scripts so communities cannot form.
options.rationale: Psychological hooks attach to emotional memory while the trap weaponizes organic human empathy.

questions.hint: Consider how parasites handle an innate virtue they cannot delete.

questions.question: How is organic empathy characterized in true soul vessels?

options.label: B

options.rationale: Psychological hooks exploit empathy while empathy itself is core spiritual firmware.

options.label: C
options.text: Empathy is an innate human capacity hardwired as core spiritual firmware that lets a true soul vessel actively share the emotional states of other beings.
options.rationale: Empathy is an innate human capacity and core spiritual firmware that enables a true soul vessel to actively share the emotional states of other beings.

options.label: D
options.text: Empathy is a temporary reaction learned through environmental conditioning and social scripts.
options.rationale: Social scripts belong to NPC mimicry while organic empathy is innate spiritual firmware.
